newsitem.title: USA: NationsBank CEO backs EPS views through 1998.
newsitem.headline: NationsBank CEO backs EPS views through 1998.

text.p: NationsBank Corp Chief Executive Hugh McColl said Wednesday he was comfortable with analysts' earnings estimates of $8.04 a share for fiscal 1996 and $8.48 for fiscal 1997.
McColl also said he backed the view that the bank would earn $10 a share in fiscal 1998, barring any significant changes in its business environment.
"If there are no changes, then I'm confident," McColl said of the 1998 estimates.
McColl, speaking to analysts, said the 1997 and 1998 estimates reflected the assumption that NationsBank would complete its pending acquisition of Boatmen's Bancshares Inc .
The 1996 estimate is for NationsBank alone, he said.
McColl said he remained interested in expanding into California but set no timetable or strategy for such a move.
Asked if there were any plans to merge with BankAmerica Corp, McColl said, "We spoke briefly last year and that's it."
Asked if NationsBank planned to expand significantly overseas, he said, "The foreign country I'm most interested in is California.
"One out of eight Americans lives in California," he said.
McColl said NationsBank would not enter California "in a little-league fashion," but he added that NationsBank might enter the state without making an acquisition.
"We may go with money and technology and marketing skills and not buy anybody," McColl said.
